items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: He brought an arrangement in for Barbra Streisand once... Barbra Streisand just didn’t like it and threw the whole thing out

ctx.x: “Harlem Nocturne” was his first, he wrote it when he was like 15 years old. I just worked for him in Palm Springs as a matter of fact. He belongs to a club called Morningside and © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

he gets little quartets. He invited me with my quartet to play, that was last month. But he brought an arrangement in for Barbra Streisand once and Earle was at the top of his form. Barbra Streisand just didn’t like it and threw the whole thing out, and he was about the second or third that she had discarded. And that to me was strange because I thought Earle could do anything for anybody, and never got a chart discarded. But it happened with her, she was very, very meticulous and she would pick what she wanted…
